latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor Edimakor — AI-assisted video editing skill.

- Edit and export polished MP4 videos from raw footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- AI-powered tools for trimming, background music, and text overlays; typical processing time: 1–2 minutes per video.
- Handles uploads, exports, credits, and session management with a cloud backend.
- Anonymous token option with 100 free credits (7 days); registration unlocks exports and premium features.
- All user requests are mapped to backend API actions, with robust error handling and status feedback.
- Exports at 1080p MP4 by default for maximum compatibility.
